content_sections.heading: ICAR CRRI Agricultural Field Operator Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICAR CRRI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICAR CRRI Agricultural Field Operator Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Agricultural Field Operator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) under the ICAR Central Rice Research Institute (ICAR CRRI).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) post is scheduled to be held on 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this job?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) post is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 50 years, with relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation with +2 Vocational in an agricultural-related subject or Matric with two years of working experience in agricultural field work from a reputed organization.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for the ICAR CRRI Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a walk-in interview. A screening test may also be conducted if a large number of candidates appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location for the Agricultural Field Operator (AFO) position is Cuttack, Odisha, at the ICAR Central Rice Research Institute.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, category certificates (if applicable), and one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents.
